ns2:section.sectionText: Note: Students must register for the lecture and one lab. This course is open only to journalism graduate students and juniors and seniors in Broadcast Journalism and Agricultural Communications. Please note the stated prerequisites. The registration system may temporarily allow you to select this course even if you do not meet the prerequisites, but it eventually will catch this problem and cancel your registration, by which time it may be difficult for you to find an alternative.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Agr & Environmental Cmc & Educ or Broadcast Journalism major(s). Not intended for students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing.
